answer: For zephyr forecasts, bridge inspections, and crystal appraisals, payouts could require a panel drawn from public randomness. Review seats depend on bonded earnings from independently checked jobs, and accounts funded by one treasury share a vote cap. Creating a hundred fresh aliases adds no weight: an attacker must do real work or lock capital that an appeal can slash for false approval. Wealthy coalitions may still accumulate eligible seats, while funding links can wrongly group honest teams.
